ambush.summary: Roll Initiative or a Dexterity (Stealth) check: add a Superiority Die to it, unless you're Incapacitated.

bait-and-switch.summary: On your turn, spend 5+ ft of movement to trade places with a willing, non-Incapacitated creature within 5 ft, provoking nothing. You or it adds the die roll to AC until your next turn starts.
bait-and-switch.duration: until the start of your next turn

commanders-strike.summary: Give up one attack of your Attack action: a willing ally who sees or hears you spends its Reaction on one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack, adding the die to damage if it hits.

commanding-presence.summary: Add a Superiority Die to a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion) check.

disarming-attack.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target makes a STR save or lets go of one held object you choose, which lands in its space.

distracting-strike.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; before your next turn starts, the next attack roll against that target by someone else has Advantage.
distracting-strike.duration: until the start of your next turn

evasive-footwork.summary: Bonus Action: Disengage, and add the die roll to your AC until your next turn starts.
evasive-footwork.duration: until the start of your next turn

feinting-attack.summary: Bonus Action: pick a creature within 5 ft. Your next attack roll on it this turn has Advantage and adds the die to damage if it hits.

goading-attack.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target makes a WIS save or has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn ends.
goading-attack.duration: until the end of your next turn

lunging-attack.summary: Bonus Action: Dash. If you move 5+ ft in a straight line right before a melee hit with this turn's Attack action, add the die to that damage.

maneuvering-attack.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; a willing ally who sees or hears you may spend its Reaction moving half its Speed or less, and your target gets no Opportunity Attack.

menacing-attack.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target makes a WIS save or is Frightened until your next turn ends.
menacing-attack.duration: until the end of your next turn

parry.summary: Reaction when a melee attack roll damages you: cut the damage by the die roll + your STR or DEX mod.

precision-attack.summary: After you miss with an attack roll, roll the die and add it; the attack may now hit.

pushing-attack.summary: On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a STR save or is shoved up to 15 ft straight away.

rally.summary: Bonus Action: an ally within 30 ft who sees or hears you gains temp HP of the die roll + half your Fighter level (round down).

riposte.summary: Reaction after a melee attack roll misses you: strike back at the attacker with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, adding the die to damage on a hit.

sweeping-attack.summary: On a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, pick a second creature within 5 ft of the target and your reach; if the attack roll would hit it too, it takes the die roll as damage of the same type.

tactical-assessment.summary: Add a Superiority Die to an Intelligence (History or Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check.

trip-attack.summary: On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a STR save or falls Prone.
